name: excalidraw-prompts
description: Suggested requests for Excalidraw drawings (.excalidraw files): what to ask about the box or arrow a member selects, and about the whole drawing.

prompts.title: Add a step after it
prompts.body: Add a new box right after the one I selected, joined to it by an arrow. Move the boxes below it down so nothing overlaps.

prompts.title: Make it a decision
prompts.body: Turn the box I selected into a question (a decision drawn as a diamond). Add the two branches out of it, labelled Yes and No, each leading to a box.

prompts.title: Add a failure path
prompts.body: Add what happens when the step I selected fails: a new box for the failure and an arrow from the selected step to it, labelled with the reason.

prompts.title: Split into two steps
prompts.body: Split the box I selected into two steps in sequence, joined by an arrow. Keep what already points to it and from it.

prompts.title: Reword this
prompts.body: Reword the selected text so it is clearer and shorter. Keep its meaning.

prompts.title: Say more
prompts.body: Expand the selected text into a fuller description, keeping it short enough to fit its box.

prompts.title: Label the arrows
prompts.body: Give each arrow in the selected area a short label saying what flows along it, if it has none.

prompts.title: Reverse the direction
prompts.body: Reverse the direction of the arrows in the selected area. Keep them attached to the same boxes.

prompts.title: Line these up
prompts.body: Line up the elements in the selected area in a neat row or column with even gaps. Keep every arrow attached.

prompts.title: Explain this part
prompts.body: Explain what the selected area shows and how it relates to the rest of the drawing. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Explain this drawing
prompts.body: Explain this drawing step by step: what it shows, how the boxes and arrows connect, and anything unclear or missing. Do not change the file.

prompts.title: Tidy the layout
prompts.body: Tidy this drawing: line up the boxes in rows or columns, use even gaps, and keep every arrow attached to the right boxes. Keep the labels and colours.

prompts.title: Check for gaps
prompts.body: Check the drawing for gaps: boxes with no arrows, arrows that lead nowhere, steps with no owner. List them and fix the clear ones.
